scripts.build: npm run build -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w ingest && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w ingest && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && npm run test -w functions && npm run test -w ingest && npm run test -w web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-finrakshak-ai "npm run test:emulator -w functions && npm run test:emulator -w ingest"
scripts.ingest: npm run build -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && npm run build -w ingest && node ingest/dist/cli.js
scripts.miner: npm run build -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && npm run build -w ingest && node ingest/dist/minerCli.js
scripts.synth: npm run build -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && npm run build -w ingest && node ingest/dist/synthCli.js
scripts.score: npm run build -w @finrakshak-ai/shared && npm run build -w ingest && node ingest/dist/risk/scoreCli.js
